# Software Engineering Rules

These rules apply to software design and implementation in every language and markup technology.
C# examples provide concrete syntax but do not narrow the rules' scope. A rule naming a
language-specific construct applies where that construct exists; other languages MUST preserve
the same design intent.

Each example isolates one rule; omitted declarations and documentation follow the other linked
rules.
